report.summary: Reviewed chunk 2 of 4 of daedalus/mapping/inventory.py. Found 15 checkable claims in docstrings/comments, all KEPT against visible code.

symbols.name: _pyproject_packages
symbols.note: Parses pyproject.toml for packages, returns sorted unique dotted names.

symbols.name: _packages_on_disk
symbols.note: Walks distribution roots to find packages with __init__.py.

symbols.name: _orphan_bytecode
symbols.note: Finds __pycache__ dirs with .pyc but no sibling .py.

symbols.name: _clean_annotation
symbols.note: Returns dict with only allowed keys that have non-empty string values.

symbols.name: annotation_overreach
symbols.note: Returns list of keys with fields not in allowed human sets.

symbols.name: _module_targets
symbols.note: Resolves entrypoints to module paths, returns all matches.

symbols.name: harvest
symbols.note: Lifts human annotations and narrative features from old inventory. Lossless by contract.

symbols.name: _feature
symbols.note: Constructs a feature dict from facts and annotations.

symbols.name: _stale_features
symbols.note: Detects stale packages (ghosts, gaps, orphan bytecode) and builds feature list.

claims.text: Dotted packages that exist under the distribution roots the metadata already names.
claims.why: Function walks only roots derived from listed names, finds dirs with __init__.py.

claims.text: Scoped to those roots on purpose: every directory in the repo with an ``__init__.py`` is not a candidate for the wheel
claims.why: Roots are computed from listed names only; function does not scan entire repo.

claims.text: ``__pycache__`` directories holding bytecode whose sources are gone.
claims.why: Finds __pycache__ dirs with .pyc files and no sibling .py files.

claims.text: A cache beside live sources is not a finding -- only one with NO sibling ``.py`` at all.
claims.why: Checks siblings list for .py files; skips if any exist.

claims.text: Annotation keys carrying fields a human is NOT allowed to set.
claims.why: Computes extra fields beyond allowed sets, returns them as list.
Function returns list of bad keys; does not modify annotations.

claims.text: The build ignores these fields either way
claims.why: Function only reports; build logic elsewhere would use allowed sets.

claims.text: Every module a hand-written feature's entrypoints resolve to.
claims.why: Iterates all entries, collects all matching module paths from known set.

claims.text: ALL of them, not the first
claims.why: Accumulates all hits; does not break after first match.

claims.text: Lift the human half out of a previous inventory. LOSSLESS by contract.
claims.why: Every feature either becomes an annotation (via _module_targets) or a narrative feature; no dropping.

claims.text: Every feature in the old document ends up in exactly one of the two: an annotation keyed to the module(s) its entrypoints name, or a verbatim narrative feature.
claims.why: If targets exist, feature becomes annotation; otherwise appended to narrative.
All features processed; no skip or discard path in loop.

claims.text: Already-schema-2 documents pass their blocks straight through
claims.why: Early return for schema 2 extracts annotations and narrative_features directly.

claims.text: The two mechanically-detectable kinds of staleness, plus the packaging picture they come from.
claims.why: Computes ghosts (in listed, not on disk), gaps (on disk, not listed), and orphans.
Only ghosts and gaps are computed; no other heuristic added.
